Distribution So far known from Mato Grosso do Sul state, Pernambuco state and Distrito Federal of Brazil (Sousa et al. 2015). In littoral zone of lakes among macrophytes.

Distribution. E. mira can be found in China Seas and is widely distributed along the western Atlantic coast of USA (Kramp 1961). In the southwestern Atlantic there are two records off northeastern Brazil — around Fernando de Noronha Island (~ 3 ° 51 ’ S; Vannucci 1957, 1958), and off Alagoas (~ 9 ° S) and Bahia coastal waters (12 ° 56 ’ S and 16 ° 29 ’ S; Goy 1979) – as well as two additional records from the temperate Argentinean shelf (37 – 38 ° S; Zamponi 1983 a; Zamponi & Suárez, 1991). The present finding is the first record of this hydromedusa from the south Brazilian coast and fulfills a gap of its known distribution.
